name: team-vr
blurb: Team cards animate in and reveal quotes on hover with color overlay and zoom.
description: Full-height section displaying team members with cascading blur-in animations on viewport entry. Each card removes grayscale and scales on hover, revealing a quote overlay. Uses TimelineAnimation for staggered reveals.
use_when: Showcasing team members with dramatic entrance and interactive hover states on a dark hero section.
avoid_when: Light-themed pages; the component hardcodes a dark neutral-950 background.
a11y: Cards have hover states for quote reveal; no keyboard navigation for quotes. Focus handling depends on parent structure.
